title: Senior FinOps Analys
description:
**Job Description**
: Looking for a highly organized, detailed and result oriented Specialist FinOps Analyst for Federal Bank multi-cloud real-estate
  
  
Federal bank uses various cloud services that run primarily on AWS, GC and Azure for IAAS PAAS and include other SAAS solutions.
  
  
The Senior FinOps Analyst would be responsible for planning and designing a highly optimized FinOps framework to run our workloads ensuring maximumutilization of resources with an effective cost management process. The role will take a strategic and forward-looking view of the Cloud FinOps function, ensuring the Bank remains prepared for evolving cloud pricing models, regulatory expectations, technology innovations, market best practices, and changing business demand.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage monthly cloud budget and forecast process in managing consumption and savings in collaboration with accounting, finance, and technical owners.
* Support stakeholders in understanding their cloud spend based on their business roadmap and budgeted forecast
* Monitor cloud consumption at the account level to detect, investigate, and escalate anomalies and unplanned spikes.
* Take a strategic and forward-looking view of the Cloud FinOps function to ensure the Bank remains prepared for evolving cloud pricing, regulatory expectations, technology shifts, market benchmarks, and changing business demand patterns
* Design, develop, and maintain reports and KPIs that provide detailed usage statistics of resources across the multi cloud landscape.
* Evaluate and investigate data patterns to derive insightful knowledge that can inform strategic and operational decisions.
* Participate in automating, integrating, and maturing the Cloud FinOps processes and data.
* Ability to understand problems, identify opportunities for improvement and provide solutions and innovative cost-cutting initiatives
* IT MIS preparation for IT department including Financial and Internal
* Assisting in preparing Cloud Budgets and tracking expenses against them
* Monthly Provisioning of cloud expenses, co-ordination with internal Finance team for timely PO, Invoicing and Payments.
* Coordinate with different business functions including IT department, Business verticals, PMO, Application build teams and to ensure corrective measures on financial MIS
* Structuring of Processes and automation of manual activities
* Create a Cloud FinOps Governance framework
* Assist in developing and maintaining unit economics and cost-to-serve reporting
* Partner with Finance to improve cloud cost transparency and reporting accuracy
* Partner with engineering teams to execute rightsizing, storage optimization, commitment utilization, and waste reduction initiatives.
* Track optimization recommendations through implementation and realization
* Monitor savings performance and report identified versus realized savings
* Support anomaly management and investigation of unexpected spend patterns
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs that provide visibility into cloud spending and optimization opportunities.
* Optimize Cloud costs by tracking cost plans, Commitment discounts, and enterprise savings plans e.g., Cloud Rate Optimization
* Develop and maintain cloud infrastructure capacity and demand forecasts monitoring and tracking of cloud capacity resource mgmt. for all services
* Define cloud cost performance KPIs, benchmarking, and tracking them
* Design and create demand for building dashboards for real-time digital tracking of FinOps by departments, attributed cost and programs to the management
* Contribute to escalation of cost and risk and issues beyond certain budget thresholds

**Budget Management Work Experience Skills**

* Overall work experience of 8+ years
* 5+ years experience working as Cloud FinOps Analyst
* 2+ years experience leading FinOps and Cloud engineering teams
* Proven track record of setting up FinOps capabilities, tooling, governance frameworks, and operating processes from scratch in complex cloud environments.
* Experience with cloud billing and cost management modules
* Good knowledge of forecasting, and predicting cost of organizations / organizational units
* Reporting and cost financial data maintenance and availability management.
* Stakeholder management and liaising with multiple verticals.
* Automation and tooling for FinOps analytics
* Good knowledge of public cloud players (AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle), their product portfolio and commercial models
* Knowledge of the core Finance principles and basic understanding of the corporate accounting process (forecast, invoicing, show back, accruals, procurement, etc.)

**FinOps Educational Qualification**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science or equivalent experience/certification or knowledge in cloud platforms with a leading CSP, or MBA with background in commercial management of cloud providers and services

This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Cloud Cost Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Cloud Cost Analyst to join our team in Kerala. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing and optimizing cloud costs across various platforms. This role is crucial for ensuring that our cloud expenditures align with our budgetary goals while maximizing the efficiency of our cloud resources. Key Responsibilities: - Analyze cloud spending patterns and identify areas for cost reduction. - Develop and implement strategies for optimizing cloud resource usage. - Collaborate with engineering and finance teams to forecast cloud costs and budgets. - Monitor cloud usage and provide regular reports on spending trends. - Stay updated on cloud pricing models and industry best practices to ensure competitive pricing. Required Skills: - Strong understanding of cloud cost management principles. - Proficiency in analyzing financial data related to cloud services. - Excellent communication skills to convey complex cost structures to non-technical stakeholders. - Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. If you are passionate about cloud technology and have a keen eye for cost management, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in optimizing our cloud investments and driving efficiency in our operations.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Business Development Manager | AWS Sales
description:
Position Summary:
   

  

 Cloud BDM will be responsible for driving growth in Ingram Micro’s cloud business through channel partners, vendors, and end customers. This role involves identifying new cloud opportunities, building strategic relationships, executing go\-to\-market plans, and ensuring revenue \& margin targets are met. The BDM must combine technical understanding of cloud services with sales acumen in a partner / distribution environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Define and execute growth strategies to increase cloud market share (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, professional/managed services)
* Identify new market segments, verticals, and geographies for cloud adoption
* Develop annual/quarterly plans and forecasts for cloud business
* Coordinate with cloud vendors (AWS, Azure, Google, etc.) for promotions, rebates, partner programs
* Align and run joint GTM campaigns and demand\-gen activities
* Leverage vendor funding and incentives (e.g. MAP, OLA) to drive adoption
* Own end\-to\-end sales cycles for key cloud deals.
* Work with presales / solution architects to framework proposals, RFP responses, PoCs
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, SLAs and close deals
* Understand and promote ancillary cloud services: migrations, modernization, security, cost optimization, managed services
* Work with internal teams to build scalable repeatable service models
* Ensure quality of cloud delivery through alignment with operations / service teams
* Collaborate with marketing to design demand generation campaigns, events, webinars, content
* Participate in industry events, conferences, and represent Ingram Micro publicly Required Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, or related field
* MBA / Postgraduate degree is a plus


 Work Experience
   

  

* 4 – 8\+ years in cloud sales / IT services / solution sales / business development
* Experience in channel / partner sales / distribution environment is preferred
* Track record of meeting or exceeding sales / revenue / margin targets
* Experience with cloud vendors (AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar) and their partner programs
* Familiarity with cloud services (migration, modernization, security, managed services)
* Exposure to large / enterprise deals and deal structuring


 Skills \& Attributes
   

  

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills
* Strong analytical mindset and data\-driven decision making
* Ability to build relationships at multiple levels (vendors, partners, customers)
* Strategic and commercial acumen, with ability to see both big picture and execution detail
* Self\-motivated, result\-oriented and entrepreneurial mindset
* Ability to work in fast\-paced, ambiguous environment
* Flexibility to travel as needed


 Certifications (Desirable)
   

  

* AWS / Azure / GCP Associate or Professional certifications
* Partner / Cloud vendor program certifications

title: Senior Solutions Architect
description:

 Oracle Cloud Solution and Technology Architect – Senior Manager
 



**Hiring Location** 
 \- Kochi / Trivandrum
 



  





**Job Summary:** 




  





 We are seeking an accomplished Oracle Cloud Solution \& Technology Architect (Senior Manager) to lead the enterprise\-wide architecture, design, governance, and delivery of Oracle Cloud solutions across Applications (ERP, HCM, SCM, CX, EPM), Technology (OCI, PaaS), Integrations, security domains. and a strong understanding of enterprise business processes. This role requires strategic leadership, collaboration with senior stakeholders, technical teams, and end\-users to drive successful enterprise\-wide Oracle application deployments.

 :

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
